skill_name: Recommend a solution to reduce pollution from vehicles
workflow: One of the most effective solutions to reduce air pollution from vehicles is to promote the use of alternative modes of transportation, such as public transportation and cycling. Governments can subsidize public transportation, install bike lanes, and encourage people to walk and bike based on their needs.
